messages:
sophia: Quick sync for NovaChip early preview: we need a compact acceptance/runbook so Legal can sign NDA handoff tomorrow. Core asks: perf suite, power/thermal stability, 99th latency <= 45ms, sustained throughput >= 1200 tokens/s, and quality delta <= 0.5% vs our controlled baseline. Any glaring omissions?

kevin: Clarify definitions: baseline model/version + dataset and tokens/s vs sequences/s. Also we should define cold vs warm starts.

maria: Baseline set: redwood/gpt-jit-v1.2 (int8), dataset devbench-2026-small (5k prompts). Throughput = tokens/s. Cold-start = first request after cache clear; warm = after 50 requests.

adam: Lab update: we have two NovaChip nodes in rack-5. Reserving Mon AM. @infra-bot can you lock the slot?

infra-bot: reservation: lab-rack-5 slot reserved 2026-03-30 09:00-17:00 (owner: adam).

kevin: Acceptance criteria for correctness: token-level perplexity <= baseline + 1.0 AND embedding cosine similarity >= 0.98. Add 8k-sequence soak with no OOMs and no kernel crashes. Capture p99 and p99.9.

sophia: Add power/thermal rules: sustained GPU power within +/-5% of baseline under sustained run, and zero thermal-throttle events. Require kernel-selection logs for reproducibility.

sam: Telemetry spec: per-request traces, kernel selection, GPU power, nvml logs. Use REDWOOD_TELEM=preview_v2 and upload to s3://redwood-preview/novachip/1766667777/. I'll wire the ingestion hook.

maria: Bench cmd (for lab):

```
./run_bench.sh --model novachip-rtxq-1.0 --dataset devbench-2026-small \
  --seq 2048 --batch 8 --quant int8 --cache-warmup 50 --cold-starts 5 \
  --out ./results.json
```

kevin: Good. Also run with long-tail probes: p99.9 capture and 8k sequence soak. Record driver and CUDA versions.

adam: I'll attach a watchdog to auto-stop on OOM and capture core dump snippets. Scheduling an extended soak Tue if needed.

sophia: Owners: maria = harness & metrics, kevin = acceptance thresholds & eval, adam = lab ops, sam = telemetry + uploads, legal handles NDA wording. We must produce a partner-redacted report for sharing.

maria: Timeline: initial perf run Mon, aggregation Tue, internal signoff Wed 10:00 PT. If pass -> preliminary report Thurs (under NDA). If fail -> triage Wed afternoon, re-run Thurs.

kevin: Note: baseline measured on hosted titanium GPU; document env diffs (clock, drivers). Add driver.version, cuda.version, kernel.hash, env.REDWOOD_RUNTIME in telemetry.

sam: Added those fields to ingestion schema.

maria: Prep checklist to attach with results: results.json, nvml.log, power.csv, kernel.log, acceptance-table.csv.

sophia: Please drop the checklist doc link here once ready so reviewers can comment. Low friction.

sam: Done: https://docs.google.com/document/d/preview-acceptance-novachip-internal (internal) 023 - reviewers: @kevin, @maria, @adam, @sophia.

maria: I'll update the doc after the run and paste partial logs. :rocket:

adam: Will post lab photos + rack serials to the doc for asset inventory.

kevin: Also propose a one-slide summary card for partner share: pass/fail, top-line metrics, next steps. We'll scrub IP before handing over.

sophia: Agreed. If anyone hits legal or IP questions, flag me and I'll loop in partnerships counsel.

adam: See you Monday. Starting pre-checks tonight.

maria: On it 1%, will post results.json when ready.

kevin: 44d
